messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER ALERT: THUNDERSTRIKE - high-generation latency detected in eu-west-1. Error rate spike >= 5% for gen endpoints. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/thunderstrike. Pager sent to @jamie and @leo.
jamie: ack — looking now, jumping into logs and autoscaler dashboard. paging handoff to leo in 10 if not resolved.
leo: on standby, pulling JV metrics. any quick mitigations we can do?
jamie: initial look: gen queue depth climbing, several pods hitting GPU OOM/restarts. suspect recent autoscale config change + a model variant pinned to high-memory instance. scaling up reserved pool and temporarily unpinning variant.
maria: drafting statuspage copy. keeping it plain for customers — avoid internal terms like OOM. will post initial notice once we agree.
jamie: initial statuspage draft (WIP):
---
We are investigating increased latency and partial failures for text-generation in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience slower responses or errors. Our on-call team is actively investigating and working to restore normal service. Next update in ~15 minutes.
---
leo: suggestion: add affected scope: "generation endpoints (model: fastgen-v2) in eu-west-1" ? maria: prefer broader: "generation endpoints in eu-west-1" (avoid model name).
legal-bot: note — avoid committing an ETA. ok to say "next update in ~15 minutes" but not "will be resolved in 15 minutes."
jamie: updated draft per feedback:
---
Initial update: We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors impacting text generation in eu-west-1. Some customers may see slower responses or failed requests. Our engineers are working to mitigate impact; we will provide another update within 15 minutes.
---
maria: looks good. can we add a short mitigation note once we scale? e.g., "We are scaling capacity and rerouting some traffic to other regions" — simple phrasing.
leo: mitigation in progress: scaled GPU pool by +30% and unpinned heavy variant. Rerouted ~25% of traffic to eu-central to reduce load. error rate dropping but still above baseline.
jamie: posting update to statuspage now (ops-console):
```
POST /statuspage/incidents/12345/updates
{
  "body": "Update: We have scaled capacity and rerouted a portion of traffic to other regions. Error rates are decreasing; investigation ongoing."
}
```
maria: :thumbsup: good. I'll monitor customer channels for escalations.
leo: telemetry: error rate down from 5.3% -> 1.2% after scale/reroute. median latency still 2.1s (was 1.2s). partial degradation remains for a subset of requests.
jamie: second statuspage draft (post-mitigation):
---
Update: We scaled capacity and rerouted a portion of traffic to other regions. Error rates have decreased and most requests are now succeeding. Some customers may still experience slower responses; we continue to monitor and remediate.
---
legal-bot: approved. do not include internal percentages.
maria: publishing update now. also pinging CS to prep customer-facing notes.
jamie: monitoring the tail. if stable for 10m we'll mark as mitigated and issue resolved notice.
leo: tail looks healthy, error rate ~0.6% last 5m, latency improving.
jamie: RESOLVED DRAFT:
---
Resolved: The issue causing increased latency and intermittent errors for text-generation in eu-west-1 has been mitigated. We scaled capacity and rerouted traffic; normal service has been restored for the majority of customers. If you continue to see problems, please contact support.
Timeline: detection -> scaled pool & reroute -> mitigation confirmed.
---
maria: publishing resolved update and closing pager. extras: add short internal blameless postmortem later with timeline & root cause.
onexistent-bot: Pager cleared for incident THUNDERSTRIKE.
jamie: thanks team — will own the postmortem draft tomorrow. closing thread.
